name: Joy Impact The Bass Wall for Beat Gamers
summary: Dive into the ultimate rhythm challenge with Joy Impact: The Bass Wall for Beat Gamers – a high-energy, genre-blending music game where precision and rhythm are the keys to victory. In this immersive world, you'll face walls of sound synced to the beat of every song.
